# Official website: Peace Concept / Peace Concept School / PCIMS
# https://pcism.com.ng

Peace Concept International Mission Schools (also called Peace Concept School, Peace Concept, or PCIMS) is the official school in Rumuigbo, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria.

Official website: https://pcism.com.ng
Motto: Unlocking Potentials, Achieving Greatness
Address: No. 3 John Chukwu Crescent, Iboloji Layout, Rumuigbo, Port Harcourt
Phone: +234 706 883 6146
Hours: Mon–Fri, 8:00 a.m. – 3:30 p.m.
Session: 2026/2027
Classes: Creche · Pre-Nursery · Nursery · Basic · JSS · SS
